preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)
Attacker must hold some amount of the CoinToken to benefit from tax manipulation

exploit_hint: As owner, set tax wallets to attacker-controlled addresses, then manipulate buy/sell taxes to divert funds. Specifically: 1) Call setTaxWallets() to set dev/marketing/charity wallets to attacker addresses. 2) Optionally adjust buy/sell taxes via setBuyTax()/setSellTax() to maximize tax collection. 3) Execute trades (buy/sell) to trigger tax collection, which will send ETH to attacker-controlled wallets. 4) Use triggerTax() to force processing of accumulated tax tokens if needed.
